remarks: Welcome to this lovely condominium in the highly sought-after Glenbrook area of Stamford, located on the Darien town line. Situated in the charming, well-maintained Riverwalk complex, this unit provides a perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Inside, you'll find 2 spacious bedrooms plus a versatile loft that can be used as a home office, additional living space, recreation or workout space. Primary bedroom includes vaulted ceiling presenting breathable space and balcony together with en-suite bathroom equipped with heated tile flooring and copper sink. Second bedroom includes a private full bathroom. The kitchen, updated from original, features quality finishes, ideal for both cooking and entertaining adjacent to spacious living/dining area with built in cabinets. Throughout the unit, crown molding adds a touch of elegance and character to each room. Hardwood floors on main level add warm ambience. Relax by the fireplace in the living room or step outside to one of the private decks to enjoy al fresco dining, coffee and natural surroundings. The partially finished lower level provides even more potential for customization, whether you need extra storage or want to create a media room, gym or more living space. Bring your own personal touches and design ideas to make this home truly yours. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of this desirable community!
